subject.title: fix(dispatch-wrapper): fix flock separator and script command detection

question: Should OpenClaw continue failing closed for Linux util-linux `script` command forms, or sponsor a separate platform-specific parser while preserving Darwin and FreeBSD semantics?
rationale: The same `script` argv has different meanings across supported platforms, and executable approval binding cannot safely apply one grammar globally.

options.title: Keep Linux fail-closed
options.body: Reject the current `script` change and retain the BSD-only parser until a separately reviewed Linux grammar is justified.

options.title: Add platform-specific Linux support
options.body: Introduce an explicit Linux util-linux parser with live execution and allow-always mismatch tests while leaving BSD parsing unchanged.

recommendation.title: Keep Linux fail-closed
recommendation.body: Reject the current `script` change and retain the BSD-only parser until a separately reviewed Linux grammar is justified.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the existing platform gate and BSD parser contract in merged feature history.
